$comment: Landing copy (EN). Written natively, not translated. Every claim is either a verified feature in code or sample data.

meta.title: Killsub — Stop paying for subscriptions you don't use
meta.description: Killsub tracks your subscriptions. It warns you 7 days and 1 day before a charge. It tells you what to cancel. Free, no card.

hero.headline: You pay for subscriptions you don't use.
hero.sub: Killsub tracks them, warns before the charge, says what to kill.
hero.note: Sample subscriptions · prices in Kč per month

a11y.scene: Animation: cards labelled with subscription names fall onto a pile. A counter adds up their monthly prices.
a11y.counter: Sum of monthly prices of the cards that have landed: {value} Kč

kill.headline:
No surprise charges.
Not anymore.
kill.sub: Three subscriptions the advisor says you don't use. Kill them.
kill.instruction: Click a card. Or focus it and press Enter.
kill.done: Done. Three cards, {value} Kč a month back.

a11y.scene: Three hanging subscription cards. Click one to shatter it. Its price is added to the saved total.

items.label: A warning before every charge. And again on the day.
The most the advisor asks before it says what to cancel.
That many are tracked for free. No card.
Pro. Unlimited subscriptions, e-mail reminders, exports.

timeline.headline:
Seven days ahead.
Not after the charge.
timeline.sub: Killsub writes before your bank does. This is the real notification text.

push.title: ⏰ Netflix renews in a week
push.body: On 12 Nov you'll be charged 329 Kč. Keep it?

pushDay.title: ⚠️ Netflix renews tomorrow
pushDay.body: 329 Kč · 12 Nov. Tap to manage the subscription.

steps.title: Add what you pay for
steps.body: Name, price, date. Or upload a CSV statement or a receipt.
steps.ui: The app's form, no sign-up, at /try

steps.title: Get told in time
steps.body: 7, 3 and 1 day before the charge. Push to phone and browser.

steps.title: See what to cancel
steps.body: Answer a few questions. The advisor matches habits to prices.
steps.ui: Portfolio score from the app · sample

rows.title: Reminders
rows.body: 7, 3 and 1 day before the charge, and on the day. Push and e-mail.

rows.title: Advisor
rows.body: Up to 6 questions. Then what to cancel, downgrade or merge.

rows.title: Import
rows.body: A CSV bank statement or a receipt. Killsub fills in the rest.

rows.title: Wrapped
rows.body: Your year on one card. How much, on what, what you saved.

overview.headline: Everything in one place.
overview.sub: How much, when and on what. The payment calendar is the app's own, with sample data.

wrapped.headline:
Your year
on one card.
wrapped.sub: At the end of the year you get a card to share. This one uses sample data.

security.headline: You enter only what you want.

facts.title: No bank connection
facts.body: Killsub never sees your account. Add subscriptions by hand or from a statement.

facts.title: Sign in with e-mail or Google
facts.body: Killsub asks for no other password.

facts.title: Export any time
facts.body: Download every subscription as CSV in one click.

closing.headline: How much is draining?
closing.sub: You'll know in three minutes. Free, no card, up to five subscriptions.
closing.fine: Free · no card · 5 subscriptions on Free
